submissionSemantics.NOT_SUBMITTED: Proven local digest/build/validation/currentness failure before observable synthetic carrier acceptance; S=0. Error text alone insufficient. Fresh explicit decision only after current prerequisites recover.
submissionSemantics.PENDING_SUBMITTED: Synthetic carrier accepts exact mutation-shaped request; S=1. No repeated submit/auto next operation.
submissionSemantics.SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN: Lost reply/opaque post-accept error/timeout/reset/loss/generation replacement/task change/disposal; retain correlation and no resend/new command/replacement mutation.
submissionSemantics.realCarrierCall: A call invocation is not proof bytes reached Host; conservative unknown unless a genuine public pre-submission/nonapplication fact exists.
submissionSemantics.differentLaterMutation: Cannot overwrite prior pending unknown or replace its guarded operation.
submissionSemantics.readonlySuccess: Status/catalogue/healthy connection does not clear uncertainty or prove nonapplication.
submissionSemantics.reconciliation: Only exact factual declared correlated successful receipt/query can reconcile what is actually proven; no invented absent fields/private receipt.
submissionSemantics.queryReady: Ready/existing idle worker is not execution/input/cursor/capture/stop/settlement proof. At most record exact actually supported existence, not unrelated mutation outcome.
submissionSemantics.lateReceipt: If sufficient public validation/correlation exists, may record original historical operation fact only; cannot restore current authority/consent or auto advance. Otherwise unknown/HOLD.
submissionSemantics.taskCancellation: Original independent task control remains possible; cancel_requested does not imply native stop/rollback/effect settlement.
submissionSemantics.missingObservableMethods: Fail closed before submission; missing proof schema/API stays HOLD.
